text:
sara.partnerships: Heads up — SkyHub is ready to sign off on VN (Ho Chi Minh) region entitlements but we need final confirmation on two things: (1) marketplace listing SKU mapping, (2) committed capacity numbers for month 1. Spreadsheet: https://rbwd.co/vn-launch-ctrack :eyes:
vinh_skyhub: confirming entitlements now. I have the marketplace product ID from our side (SH-VN-LLM-01). Will need your committed throughput number to request quota from infra team.
kevin_infra: what GPU types are we targeting? t4/rtx? need SKU to request host placements in VN edge zones.
na na (note: placeholder, replaced)
anita_prod: small compliance note — VN requires data residency clause and SOC-like audit doc. @sara.partnerships can you upload the redlined contract to the doc? otherwise legal will delay. :grimacing:
sara.partnerships: yes — uploading redline in 10m. We plan three SKUs: small (4xA10G), medium (8xA10G), large (16xA10G). Kevin, use those for initial quota request. Goal: be able to sustain 200 rps prefix-cached inference for medium SKU.
vinh_skyhub: FYI our marketplace team expects the listing to include a free trial token bucket (30 credits) and an approved support matrix. I can get marketplace metadata once you confirm SKUs.
kevin_infra: noted. I'll open a quota ticket with SkyHub infra and put the SKU list + expected concurrency. Ticket will include template: ```
{
  "region": "vn-ho-chi-minh",
  "skus": ["4xA10G","8xA10G","16xA10G"],
  "requested_capacity": {"small": 10, "medium": 6, "large": 2},
  "target_date": "2026-05-12"
}
```
mike_retail: quick product ask — include a canary route that pins to open-llm-v2-small for the marketplace trial. Want to ensure fallback to hosted-redwood-lr if latency > 300ms.
vinh_skyhub: we can do canary routes on our side but need the model image names and container registry read role. Send IAM role to me.
anita_prod: legal: adding data residency clause draft to the same sheet. also need to confirm logging retention (default 90 days) — is that acceptable?
sara.partnerships: 90 days okay for now. We'll offer extended retention as paid add-on.
kevin_infra: ticket created: https://skyhub.inc/tickets/6792 — I've CC'ed @vinh_skyhub and attached the SKU JSON. ETA on quota approval 3-5 business days according to support.
vinh_skyhub: approving fast-path for launch partner bundles. I submitted internal ops note to reserve 120 A10G-equivalent cards in VN region for May. Re: marketplace listing, I'll share the draft metadata tonight.
deploy-bot: scheduled: infra-check-vn (region availability) at 2026-05-05 02:00 UTC — running preflight checks.
sara.partnerships: awesome — action items: 1) @vinh_skyhub share marketplace metadata + IAM role, 2) @kevin_infra confirm ticket progress and quota numbers, 3) @anita_prod upload redline and logging TTL consent. I'll compile partner launch checklist after we have all pieces. :thumbsup:
kevin_infra: will follow up in ticket if anything blocks.
vinh_skyhub: will update by EOD PST.
